doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: An all-colored show under a white doctor; mixed audience
summary: Everyone in the show except Dr. Moon and his wife was colored, and the standing audiences were mixed.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: was everybody on the show white people, all the other musicians and so on?
it was all colored. All colored, except for Dr. Mooningfield. That's right. Except for Dr. Mooningfield.
And his wife. And his wife. And the people who came. And me. And you. I'm a Creole. And you. But how about the people who came? Well, you had a mixed audience. Mixed audience. Oh, yeah.
And, uh, they would have to stand, you know, they didn't have any seats then. Uh-huh. They would stand on this empty lot and listen to the show.
